📖 External Backend & Flutter API Integration Guide (Click to Expand)

1. Incoming APIs from your Backend to Game:

  • POST /api/webhook/user/sync-balance - Sync user wallet balance in real-time
  • POST /api/webhook/user/add-coins - Add coins to a player
  • POST /api/webhook/player/bet - Place bet on behalf of user
  • GET /api/game/state - Fetch real-time room state
  • GET /api/webhook/docs - View complete event schemas

2. Verifying HMAC-SHA256 Signature in your backend (Node.js):

const crypto = require('crypto');
const secret = 'live_stream_slot_secret_2024';
const expectedSig = crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(rawBody).digest('hex');
if (req.headers['x-slot-signature'] === expectedSig) {
  // Signature verified! Process event: req.body.event
}
